identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16] Register three-platform distributed native proof workflow

values.task_boundary: Create, prove, independently review, publish, shepherd, and merge only the WP-04 native distributed workflow and issue #137 lifecycle/proof surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Manual dispatch requires an exact 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA and checks out exactly that revision.
AC-2: A bounded matrix runs Linux, macOS, and Windows with Rust and cargo-nextest installed and the existing producer invoked through Bash.
AC-3: Each platform uploads a distinct fail-closed receipt fragment and Ubuntu downloads all fragments for validation with the existing aggregate validator.
AC-4: Actions are commit-pinned, permissions are read-only, timeouts are bounded, and no #5878 producer, validator, manifest, or evidence file changes.
AC-5: Focused workflow contract validation, repository path-policy validation, diff hygiene, exact-head independent review, and full hosted CI pass.
dependencies: Existing #5878 producer and aggregate validator at origin/main
non_goals: Changing #5878 product code, producer, validator, manifest, or evidence
Claiming native proof before hosted jobs execute
Adding secrets, write permissions, schedules, or unbounded jobs
